start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles zyada pasand hain ya squares?

turns.line: samajh nahi aaya, ek example se samjhao
turns.reply: Jaise garden ko fence karna ho: perimeter matlab poori boundary ki length. 6 m aur 4 m sides hain; aap sabhi sides kaise jodenge?
Rectangle ki chaar sides 6, 4, 6, 4 m hain. Perimeter ke liye sab jodiye: 6 plus 4 plus 6 plus 4. Total kitna?

turns.board: Rani runs 3 rounds of a rectangular park 50 m long and 30 m wide. How far does she run?
turns.reply: 6 plus 4 equals 10, phir 6 plus 4 equals 10; dono jodiye, perimeter 20 m. Aap next time chaar sides likhkar jodiye.
